transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, um, thank you for seeing me. I hope I'm not wasting your time or anything. I guess I'm just here because... well, things have been a little off lately. I moved into this new room recently, and, um, it's not in the best shape. I mean, it's fine, I can handle it, but I've been staying up late trying to fix leaks and deal with the heat, you know? 

And I guess... well, I might be snapping at people a little more than usual. Just a bit on edge. And, um, I've been dragging myself into work a little late, maybe messing up a few things I normally have down pat. Nothing major, I swear! Just... not my best work. Is that the kind of thing you need to know? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?

Sad? Um, no, I wouldn't say I'm sad. I mean, I'm definitely not sitting around crying or anything like that. I really hope I don't sound like I'm just in here complaining. 

It's mostly just... well, just the stress with the room and being so tired, you know? But not depressed or down. I'm usually a pretty upbeat guy, I promise. Is it okay if it's just stress? I don't want to give you the wrong idea or answer the question wrong.
Have you been feeling anxious or worried about anything lately?

Anxious? Oh, no, not really. I mean, I'm not sitting around biting my nails or, like, having panic attacks or anything crazy like that. I hope that's a good thing? 

I guess I just... I worry a normal amount, like anybody would about fixing up a place that's falling apart a little. It's just regular stuff, you know? Like, 'Did I patch that pipe right?' or 'Is the landlord gonna fix the AC?' But nothing major. I'm not, like, an anxious person overall. Does that make sense? I just don't want you to think I'm making a big deal out of nothing.
Have you been feeling more tired than usual lately?

Tired? Um, well, I guess a little bit, yeah. But I mean, anybody would be, right? With the heat and trying to fix up the room after a long shift... it's just normal tired. I'm definitely not, like, sleeping all day or too exhausted to get out of bed. I still get up and go to work! 

I'm just maybe dragging a little more than usual in the mornings. But it's nothing I can't handle, I promise. I just drink a little extra coffee and push through. Is that... is that normal for this kind of thing? I just want to make sure I'm not complaining about normal stuff.
Are you avoiding any activities or places because of your current situation?

Avoiding things? Oh, no, definitely not. I mean, I'm not hiding out in my room or anything like that. I still go to work every day, and I still talk to the guys on the site. I'm not, like, shutting myself away from the world. I hope that's what you mean?

I guess I haven't been going out as much after work, but that's just because I've been trying to get the room sorted out, you know? And it's so hot in there, by the time I'm done messing with it, I just kind of want to stay put. But I'm not avoiding anywhere specifically. I'm still doing all the things I need to do. Is that the right answer? I just don't want you to think I'm completely isolating myself or anything bad like that.
Have you been enjoying the things you normally like to do?

Enjoying things? Yeah, I mean, I think so. I still like watching the game on the weekends when I can catch it, or, you know, grabbing a beer. I haven't really stopped liking the stuff I usually like. 

I guess maybe I just haven't had as much time for it lately, with the room and work and everything. So maybe I'm not doing it as much, but it's not like I don't *want* to. I just... I don't know, I guess I just haven't been as into it the last couple of weeks? But that's probably just because I'm busy, right? It doesn't mean anything's wrong with me, does it? I'm still a pretty normal guy, I think.
Are there things that you used to enjoy doing, but now don't find pleasure in?

No, not really. I mean, I think I pretty much still like all the same stuff. Like I said, I still like watching sports and hanging out when I get the chance. I haven't, like, completely lost interest in everything. 

I guess maybe I just haven't been as excited about things lately? But I think that's just because I've been a little stressed with the living situation and everything. It's not like I sit around and hate the things I used to love. I'm still me, you know? I hope that makes sense. I just don't want to sound like I'm totally depressed or something, because I'm definitely not. That's a good thing, right?
Do you feel like you're able to experience a full range of emotions like you used to?

Emotions? Oh, yeah, definitely. I mean, I can still get happy or mad or whatever. I'm not, like, numb or turned into a robot or anything like that. I still laugh when the guys make a joke at work, you know? 

I guess maybe I've just been a little more... I don't know, frustrated lately? Just with the heat in the room and trying to get settled. But I think anyone would feel that way, right? It's totally normal to be a little on edge when you're dealing with all that. But yeah, I still feel everything just fine. I hope that's what you were looking for? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right picture here. I'm doing okay, really.
Do you feel like you're able to feel emotions as strongly as you used to?

As strongly? Yeah, for sure. I mean... I don't think anything's changed with that. I still get just as fired up if my team wins, or, you know, just as aggravated if something goes wrong at the site. It's not like the volume got turned down on how I feel or anything. 

I'm still a hundred percent me in that department. That's a good sign, right? Like, it means I'm just dealing with some regular stress and not going crazy or getting, like, severely depressed? I just want to make sure you know I'm basically doing alright. Am I making sense?
Do you feel like anything is missing from your emotional experiences lately?

No, nothing's missing. I mean, like I said, I still feel everything just fine. I don't feel empty or blank or anything weird like that. 

I guess I'm just... I'm just a normal guy dealing with some annoying stuff right now, you know? The moving, the heat, all that. But emotionally, I'm all here. There's no big hole or anything missing. I'm handling it okay, don't you think? Like, this all sounds pretty standard for someone in my spot, right?
Do you feel like you're less sensitive to things that normally would upset you?

Less sensitive? Um, no, I wouldn't say that. I mean, if something happens that should upset me, it still upsets me. I'm not, like, brushing off things that actually matter. 

I guess I just... I try not to let the little things get to me too much, you know? Like, you gotta roll with the punches sometimes, especially on a job site. But I definitely still care about things. I'm not turning cold or anything like that. That's a good thing, right? Like, it shows I'm still reacting to things the right way? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right idea here.
Do you feel like you're unable to feel emotions as intensely as you used to in certain situations?

Um... no, not really. Wait, did I say something earlier that made it sound like I was going numb or something? Because I really didn't mean to give you that impression. 

Like I was saying, the intensity is all still there, no matter what the situation is. I haven't lost any of that. I'm sorry if I'm not explaining it right, but I promise I'm still feeling things exactly the same as I always have. 

That's a healthy thing, right? I just really want to make sure I'm giving you the right answers and not making things sound worse than they are. I'm doing okay in that department, I swear.
Have you noticed yourself losing interest in things you normally enjoy doing?

No, I wouldn't say I've lost interest. I mean, I still like doing the stuff I usually do. 

I guess I've just been a little tired lately from the move and work being so busy, so maybe I haven't been doing as much of it? But it's not because I don't want to. I still care about my hobbies and everything. I'm just pacing myself a bit, you know? That makes sense, right? It's normal to just want to chill out when you've got a lot on your plate, isn't it? I just don't want you to think I'm, like, giving up on things. I'm still the same guy.
Do you feel like you're experiencing emotions less intensely than you used to?

Um, didn't you just ask me that? Or... wait, did I answer it wrong before? I'm sorry if I confused you. 

But, uh, no. Like I was trying to say, my feelings are just as strong as they've always been. I definitely haven't lost any, like, intensity or whatever. I still feel everything just fine. 

I'm really trying to be clear here, I promise. Did that answer it better this time? I just want to make sure I'm giving you what you need.
Do you feel like there are times when you can't feel anything at all?

Uh, no, never. Like, completely blank? No, I definitely don't get like that. 

Man, I feel like I'm failing a test or something since we keep coming back to this kind of thing. I'm really sorry if I'm messing up the questions or giving you weird answers. 

But yeah, I never just feel *nothing*. I'm always feeling something, even if it's just, you know, being a little stressed about the job site or whatever. That's how it's supposed to be, right? I'm not trying to hide anything from you, I promise. I'm just a regular guy, and I just want to make sure I'm doing this right and giving you what you're looking for.
Do you feel like you're having trouble feeling emotional reactions to things that would normally provoke a strong emotional response in you?

Oh, man... I feel like I'm really letting you down here, because that kind of sounds like the same thing we've been talking about, right? And I still don't have that. Like, if a guy gets hurt on the site or something, or if I get some really good news, I still get totally worked up about it just like I always would. I definitely still react to things. 

Am I... am I supposed to be feeling like that? Because if I am, I can try to think harder on it, but... I really just react to stuff like normal. I hope that's okay? I'm really sorry if I'm being difficult or not giving you what you need, I promise I'm trying my best to give you the right answers.
Do you ever feel like you're just going through the motions of daily life without really feeling anything?

Oh, man... I swear I'm not trying to be difficult, but... no. I really don't. 

I mean, I know I'm probably frustrating you since we keep circling back to this same kind of thing, and I'm really sorry about that. I feel like I keep giving you the wrong answer. But, like, when I get up and go to the site, I'm not just a zombie or anything. I feel normal stuff. I get tired, I get annoyed, I get glad when the shift is over... I'm definitely feeling it all. 

Are you sure I'm not supposed to be feeling numb? Because I can tell you're really looking for that, and I hate that I keep letting you down with my answers. I'm really trying to do this right, I promise. Is it... is it bad that I don't feel that way?
Do you ever feel like you're unable to feel emotions at all, even for a short period of time?

Oh, man... I feel terrible. I really do. You've asked this a few different ways now, and I just keep giving you the same answer. I swear I'm not trying to be stubborn or hide anything from you. 

Even for a short time... no, I don't think my emotions ever just turn off like that. Like, maybe I zone out for a minute staring at my phone after a really long shift, but that's just being tired, right? It's not like I'm completely blank inside. I still feel it all.

I really wish I could give you a different answer so you could check off whatever box you're looking at. I'm so sorry. I hope I'm not wasting your time or, you know, ruining the evaluation. Am I doing okay otherwise? I just want to make sure I'm helping you figure this out.
Do you ever feel like you're unable to feel emotions for more than a day at a time?

Doc, I feel like a broken record, and I am so, so sorry. I know you keep asking about this, and I feel awful that I can't give you the answer you're looking for. But no, definitely not for a whole day. I never really lose my feelings like that. 

I really hope I'm not making your job harder by saying no again. I swear I'm being completely honest with you, I'm not trying to hold anything back or be difficult. Are we... are we okay? I just really want to make sure I'm giving you what you need for your notes. Is it a bad sign that I don't have that symptom? I just want to make sure I'm doing this right.
Do you feel like there are times when nothing seems to bother you or excite you, even when it normally would?

Oh, geez... I'm really sorry. I feel like I'm failing a test here or something. I know you're trying to figure out if I have this... this numbness thing going on, and I hate to keep saying no. 

But, um... no. I don't really have times where nothing bothers me or excites me. Like, if my buddy brings me a coffee on site, I'm happy about it. If my boss yells at me, it definitely bothers me. I react to stuff normally, I think. 

I'm really, really sorry I keep shooting down this question. I promise I'm trying to think hard about it, I'm not just brushing you off. I hope I'm not being a frustrating patient. Is it... is it okay that I'm just, you know, feeling things the regular amount? I'm doing my best here, I swear.
